snippet.title: Knightblade Trailer - Indie Retro Open World RPG, Farming Sim, & Dungeon Crawler
snippet.description:
A retro open world RPG, farming sim, and dungeon crawler. Knightblade is best described as an open world fantasy game mixed with farming and life sim elements, as if it were made in the golden age of video games. Create your character, and explore the sandbox while solving a mystery. Now available on Steam, and Itch.io!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1938530/Knightblade/
https://solohack3r.itch.io/knightblade

Music by Rest! (Ricardo Cuello)
